In this video, Firstpost explains why anti-Indian racism, colonial stereotypes and the offensive ‘Indian smell’ stereotype persist in the digital age. From racial discrimination to social media hate, we examine why Indians face prejudice in Western countries. Gursshheen Gahllen brings you the details on Firstpost America.
